name: Mercedes Haefer
biography: In July 2011, Mercedes was indicted along with 13 others (dubbed the Anonymous 14) for allegedly conspiring to commit distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks against PayPal’s website as part of an alleged Anonymous Operation Payback. (allegedly) Mercedes is enrolled as a sociology undergraduate at the University of Nevada and Las Vegas. Twitter: @usagi_the_bunny
